summary: Kevin Park, a Santa Clara councilmember, is credited in a December 2023 Silicon Valley Voice opinion piece with championing a Gaza ceasefire resolution, an effort the article reports was blocked. The CAIR-SFBA tracker lists his support for a ceasefire resolution the same period. CAIR Action places him in its preferred tier, and BAMC Action supports his candidacy noting his consistency in support of Muslims.
